summary.text: Jeremy Cooney is a Democratic state senator who represents New York State Senate District 56 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Cooney, a former chief of staff to the mayor of Rochester, has been a state senator since 2021 and is the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate.

paragraphs.text: Jeremy Cooney lives in Rochester, New York, and earned a B.A. from Hobart and William Smith Colleges and a J.D. from Albany Law School.
His career experience includes working as chief of staff for Rochester Mayor Lovely Warren and as senior director for community relations with Empire State Development.
He serves as vice chair of the executive board of the Seneca Waterways Council.
Cooney has represented State Senate District 56 since 2021, succeeding Joseph Robach (R).

In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Transportation Committee and is also assigned to the Cultural Affairs, Tourism, Parks and Recreation; Ethics and Internal Governance; Civil Service and Pensions; Judiciary; Codes; Finance; and Insurance committees.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Cooney faces Orlando Rivera (R / Conservative Party).
